title: Photovoltaic Technology Advances
text: Photovoltaic (PV) technology converts light directly into electricity via the photovoltaic effect. Silicon solar cells remain the dominant technology, accounting for about 95% of global production, with monocrystalline silicon cells achieving efficiencies above 26% in laboratory conditions. Perovskite solar cells have emerged as a promising next-generation technology, achieving lab efficiencies exceeding 25% at lower manufacturing costs than silicon. Multi-junction cells, which stack several semiconductor layers to capture different portions of the solar spectrum, have achieved record efficiencies above 47% under concentrated sunlight. The levelized cost of solar electricity fell by 89% between 2010 and 2020, making utility-scale solar the cheapest source of new electricity generation in most of the world.
